audio_graphs.activation_semantics: When Document.AudioBuses is empty, use the legacy implicit direct-master graph: every audio track has empty audio_bus_id and no route/gain/pan graph capability is required. Any non-empty AudioBuses array activates the explicit graph and requires all listed capabilities, even when authored gain/pan values are identity.
audio_graphs.agent_description: Deterministic single-parent audio mix graph with explicit route, gain and linear-balance pan semantics; use another profile for sends, effects, surround or equal-power pan.
audio_graphs.evaluation_order: For each clip evaluate source samples, clip gain, clip pan and its track route. For each bus evaluate the stable input sum, bus gain, bus pan and then its single parent edge. The master emits after its own gain and pan. This profile adds no hidden normalization, limiter, saturation or fallback route.
audio_graphs.optional_processing_semantics: The base graph capabilities never imply extra processing. An authored cutly.audio.channel-matrix.stereo.v1 stage runs after source decode/retime and before clip gain/pan. An authored cutly.audio.limiter.sample-peak-instant.v1 stage is valid only on the master and runs after master gain/pan. Their independent capabilities, evaluator profiles, media preflight, state/latency and rounding boundaries are defined by their PropertyDescriptors; omission means the stages do not exist.
audio_graphs.pan_semantics: For exact pan p in [-1,1], left gain=min(1,1-p) and right gain=min(1,1+p). Mono duplicates to L/R before gains; stereo balances channels independently with no crossfeed; other layouts fail preflight unless an explicit channel-matrix capability first produces stereo. Equal-power and surround pan require a different versioned profile.
audio_graphs.routing_semantics: Every track has at most one route. In an explicit graph each audio track routes to exactly one existing bus; non-audio tracks cannot route. Empty audio_bus_id is forbidden once the explicit graph is active.
audio_graphs.summation_semantics: Rendering selects exactly one timeline. At each bus, sum its direct track signals in that selected timeline's track-array order, followed by child-bus signals in Document.AudioBuses order. The declared order is the stable tie-breaker; host map iteration, graph traversal order and backend optimization cannot reorder the semantic mix.
audio_graphs.topology_semantics: An explicit graph contains exactly one master bus. Every group bus has exactly one existing parent and every parent chain terminates at the master; cycles, orphan groups, implicit buses and sends are forbidden.

interpolations.value_semantics: Normalize segment time p exactly. For 0=p. Evaluate x/y with exact rationals, then apply exact component-wise a+(b-a)*y. p<=0 and p>=1 return exact endpoints. No CSS or floating-point solver is permitted.
Return the left keyframe value throughout its half-open segment; at the right keyframe offset that keyframe value wins. This is the only Document v2 interpolation for color.
Normalize segment time p exactly and evaluate every rational component as a+(b-a)*p with arbitrary-precision rational intermediates. No intermediate rounding is permitted.

properties.agent_description: Exact, probe-bound source-channel matrix to stereo; use it for layouts that the base mono/stereo graph cannot consume.

bindings.keyframe_semantics: Channel matrices are static for the complete clip and cannot be keyframed in v1.

properties.migration_description: Document v1 has no typed channel matrix; an identically named raw legacy property remains in the capability-gated legacy envelope until explicitly migrated.
properties.value_semantics: Before clip gain and pan, media preflight must match source_layout exactly to ProbeManifest audio.channel_layout, match len(source_channels) to ProbeManifest audio.channels, and prove that the selected decoder exposes its input channels in exactly the authored source_channels order. No layout expansion, channel inference, or reordering is implicit. Emit stereo with L=sum(input[i]*left_coefficients[i]) and R=sum(input[i]*right_coefficients[i]) using arbitrary-precision rational intermediates. Results may exceed nominal [-1,1] full scale. Apply no implicit normalization, clipping, fallback layout, or rounding; only an explicitly authored downstream limiter or the separately versioned final PCM quantization profile may handle out-of-range values. When omitted, cutly.audio.graph.v1 keeps its mono/stereo-only input rule.

properties.agent_description: Linear clip gain where 1/1 is unity and 0/1 is silence.

bindings.keyframe_semantics: Audio-bus gain is static for the complete bus and cannot be keyframed in v1.

properties.migration_description: Migrate only the exact cutly.audio.gain.v1 legacy key with a JSON number or strict {value:number}; malformed known values fail migration.
properties.value_semantics: Linear amplitude multiplier; values are exact, non-negative ratios and 1/1 is unity. Placement in the mix pipeline and the prohibition on hidden normalization are defined once by cutly.audio.graph.v1.

properties.agent_description: Explicit zero-latency stereo-linked sample-peak limiter; not a true-peak limiter.

bindings.keyframe_semantics: The master sample-peak limiter is static for the complete render and cannot be keyframed in v1.

properties.migration_description: Document v1 has no typed master limiter; raw legacy properties remain capability-gated extensions.
properties.value_semantics: After master gain and pan, process each exact stereo sample in nominal full-scale units; the input may exceed [-1,1]. With linked peak=max(abs(L),abs(R)), silence uses gain 1 and other samples use gain=min(1,ceiling_linear/peak). Multiply both channels by the same exact gain. The stage is instantaneous and stateless with zero lookahead and zero latency; it has no attack/release, oversampling, inter-sample or true-peak claim, hidden makeup gain, saturation, or internal rounding. Final PCM quantization belongs to a separately versioned output profile. When omitted, no limiter is applied.

properties.value_semantics: Exact pan p in [-1/1,1/1], with -1 left, 0 center and 1 right. The single authoritative linear-balance law, mono/stereo handling, unsupported layouts and pipeline order are defined by cutly.audio.graph.v1.

properties.agent_description: Routes an audio track to one declared bus; an empty ID is valid only for the legacy direct-master graph.

bindings.keyframe_semantics: Routing is static for the complete track and cannot be keyframed.

properties.migration_description: A v1 audio track migrates to the implicit direct-master graph; an explicit bus graph must be authored in v2.
properties.value_semantics: One exact track-to-bus edge; an empty ID denotes the legacy direct-master graph only. The authoritative topology, routing and summation contract is cutly.audio.graph.v1.

properties.value_semantics: Normalized full decoded source-surface rectangle: x/y are the top-left origin and width/height stay inside [0,1]². Crop is evaluated before transform; 0/1,0/1,1/1,1/1 is identity and no out-of-bounds sampling is implied.

properties.migration_description: Migrate only the exact cutly.transform.v1 legacy key with strict numeric position, scale, rotation_degrees, and anchor members; malformed known values fail migration.
properties.value_semantics: For source pixel point p and anchorPixels=(anchor.x*sourceWidth,anchor.y*sourceHeight), evaluate p'=position+anchorPixels+R_clockwise(rotation)*scale*(p-anchorPixels). Position is translation in output-surface square pixels (+x right, +y down); anchor is normalized full-source space; scale is a signed unitless ratio (negative mirrors); rotation is clockwise degrees in the y-down output plane. Crop is selected first, but anchor remains relative to the full source. Identity is position 0, scale 1, rotation 0, anchor 1/2.

sources.agent_description: Deterministic plain text source; it does not accept HTML, CSS, host fonts, locale inference, bidi inference, or missing-glyph substitution.
sources.keyframe_semantics: Evaluate offsets in clip-local time; clamp before the first keyframe to its value and at/after the last to its value. Hold returns the left value on each half-open keyframe interval. Linear interpolation of scalar, point and rect values uses exact rational progress and exact per-component rational lerp. For cubic-bezier, first compare exact x at the maximum interior Q0.32 point k=2^32-1; if x
sources.value_semantics: Shape the exact UTF-8 text with the pinned font asset, exact font size, explicit language, direction and alignment; U+000A is the only automatic line-break control and fill is unpremultiplied sRGB RGBA16. The source is immutable at every mapped source time: SourceRange preserves edit/migration identity but never requests retime or transition handles. Media preflight fails when the pinned font cannot shape every required glyph; there is no host-font fallback.

sources.agent_description: Deterministic viewport-bound fill path source for a first native vector slice; intrinsic raster geometry and viewBox mapping are explicit, with no SVG/XML/CSS, scripts, external references, host DPI, stroke, or curve fallback.
sources.value_semantics: Rasterize into the declared RasterViewport in top-down square-pixel edge coordinates with no host-DPI or physical-size interpretation. ViewBox coordinates remain exact user units and are never pixels: for viewport W,H and viewBox origin vx,vy and size vw,vh, use exact rational s=min(W/vw,H/vh) and map (x,y) to ((W-s*vw)/2+s*(x-vx),(H-s*vh)/2+s*(y-vy)); this is fixed xMidYMid meet. Leave uncovered viewport pixels transparent and clip all coverage to the viewport. Only move_to, line_to and close are accepted; every path is fill-only with an explicit nonzero/evenodd rule. For fill, each open subpath is conceptually closed by a straight segment from its current point to its most recent move_to when the next move_to begins or the path ends; this does not insert a command into canonical bytes. Fill values are inline unpremultiplied sRGB RGBA16 and use cutly.color.rgba16-srgb-straight-paint-to-linear-bt709-premultiplied-rgba16.v1 before paths paint in array order with source-over compositing. Cubic commands and strokes are rejected rather than approximated. The source is immutable at every mapped source time: SourceRange preserves edit/migration identity but never requests retime or transition handles.

sources.agent_description: Deterministic path vector source; all pixel-affecting path and stroke rules are explicit, and SVG/XML/CSS, scripts, external references and URL-valued paints are excluded.
sources.value_semantics: Interpret exact rational move, line, cubic and close commands in the declared viewBox. An open subpath is implicitly closed for fill only and remains open for stroke. Every path declares nonzero/evenodd fill rule; every centered stroke declares positive width, butt/round/square cap, miter/round/bevel join and positive miter limit. Paints are inline unpremultiplied sRGB RGBA16; no rasterizer default may alter these rules. The source is immutable at every mapped source time: SourceRange preserves edit/migration identity but never requests retime or transition handles.

transitions.agent_description: Cross-dissolve adjacent video/image clips using explicit asymmetric windows; missing temporal-video handles fail preflight and are never synthesized by repeating a video edge frame.
transitions.compositing_semantics: In linear-light premultiplied-alpha space, outgoing weight is 1-progress and incoming weight is progress.
transitions.progress_semantics: For non-zero total window W=pre_duration+post_duration and timeline time t, progress=(t-(C-pre_duration))/W. At window start progress is 0; at its half-open end the transition has ended and incoming alone is visible.
transitions.window_semantics: For cut time C, evaluate the half-open window [C-pre_duration,C+post_duration). Temporal incoming video before C uses source head handle and temporal outgoing video at/after C uses source tail handle; a static image is held as its immutable frame on either side and needs no temporal handle. The transition never changes timeline duration or clip positions.
transitions.zero_duration_semantics: pre_duration=0 and post_duration=0 is exactly a hard cut, requires no transition capability, and may be removed by v1 down-conversion.
